This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin and elongated faces.<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[1 BBY]], a member of this species could be found within the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] when [[Kleya Marki]] arrived in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Make It Stop|tenth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="Make It Stop" /> directed by [[Alonso Ruizpalacios]] and aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
